text:
joel (Acme Corp): Hey team — our tenant (acme-prod) is missing usage points in the Console for the last ~6 hours. Charts flatlined around 03:20 UTC. Any ideas?

sam (Support): Sorry to hear that — can you confirm tenant id and one sample request_id / API timestamp if you have it? Also are you still seeing successful API responses? :thinking: 

joel (Acme Corp): Tenant id is acme-prod, sample request_id: req_0a1b2c3d, timestamp 2026-03-18T03:18:42Z. API responses look fine from our side (200s), but dashboard shows zero tokens for that window.

sam (Support): Thanks. I'm going to poke the ingestion pipeline and analytics rollups. @maria can you check consumer lag + ETL worker errors? I'll DM Joel for any logs.
maria (SRE): Looking at ingestion cluster now. Kafka consumer group `console-usage-consumer` shows sustained lag for the `usage_hourly` topic. Current consumer_lag ~ 124,500 messages (~4.5 hours behind). Also seeing repeated backpressure logs on worker-3: 
```
2026-03-18T03:21:05Z worker-3 WARN queue.backpressure: throttle=true pending=1200
2026-03-18T03:21:45Z worker-3 ERROR etl.process: downstream-write-timeout 504
```
Seems like writes to rollups DB were timing out after a deploy around 03:15 UTC.

ash (Eng-Infra): Noted. There was a deploy at 03:12 that bumped connection_pool_max on rollups writer; suspect we hit pool exhaustion under burst. Rolling restart might free connections. Planning: 1) restart etl workers (canary then full), 2) temporarily increase DB connection_pool_max for rollups writer, 3) trigger backfill run for affected time range.

sam (Support): Joel — short-term workaround: we can kick off a targeted backfill for your tenant only; it won't affect your API calls. Would you like us to proceed? ETA ~3 hours for backfill to complete depending on DB write throughput.
joel (Acme Corp): Please proceed, that would be great. Any risk of duplicate billing events?
sam (Support): Backfill only replays aggregate records for Console; it does not re-ingest billing events to billing pipeline. No duplicate billing. We'll monitor.
maria (SRE): Starting canary restart of worker-1 (03:44 UTC). Observing consumer lag drop on canary: lag -> 112k -> 95k within 8m. After canary success, rolling to remaining workers.
ops-bot: DeployBot: canary-restart worker-1 started by maria at 2026-03-18T03:44:12Z
ash (Eng-Infra): Increased rollups DB connection_pool_max from 60 -> 120 for the writer user. Watch window open for 30m.
maria (SRE): Workers rolled, DB pool increased, and write timeouts cleared. Consumer lag now 18,200 (approx 40m behind). We'll submit targeted backfill job: command below.
```
# targeted backfill for tenant acme-prod between 2026-03-18T02:00 and 2026-03-18T06:00
./bin/backfill --tenant acme-prod --start 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z --end 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z --concurrency 8 --dry-run=false
```

sam (Support): Backfill kicked off (job id bf_20260318_acme_7). Monitor link: https://internal.redwood/internals/backfills/bf_20260318_acme_7 :eyes: 
maria (SRE): Backfill progress: 10% -> 50% -> 90% over 2h. Finalizing writes and running verification queries to ensure counts match. Verification snippet: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM usage_rollups WHERE tenant_id='acme-prod' AND hour >= '2026-03-18 02:00' AND hour < '2026-03-18 06:00';
-- expected ~= 18,432 rows, inserted 18,430, replayed 2 rows deduped
```

ash (Eng-Infra): Post-backfill: consumer_lag now < 1k and rollups write latency back to normal. Leaving DB pool at 120 for 1 hour then will revert.
sam (Support): Joel — backfill completed at 06:07 UTC, Console got updated for the missing window. Can you confirm you see metrics restored on your side? :thumbsup: 
joel (Acme Corp): I can see the charts updating now, looks correct. Thank you everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
sam (Support): Closing the escalation but leaving monitoring on for 2 hours. Filing follow-up action items: rollback DB pool change if stable, add connection_pool autoscaling to runbook, add tagging to backfill jobs for tenant/incident id.
maria (SRE): Followup ticket created: INT-3251 — add autoscale to rollups writer and tune backpressure thresholds.
ash (Eng-Infra): Will add a postmortem note if we see recurrence.
sam (Support): Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
